title: EMU at the stationary and 80 km/h pass-by limits
why: The EMU rows apply; the PRM TSI's dB figures for door signals are not noise limits.

spec.name: EMU at the stationary and 80 km/h pass-by limits

noise.stationary_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.1 Table 2 (LpAeq,T[unit]: electric locomotives 70, diesel locomotives 71, EMUs 65, DMUs 72, coaches 64, wagons 65 dB): EMU row, 65 ≤ 65.

noise.pass_by_80_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): EMU row, 80 ≤ 80.
